tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Individual disclosed congressional stock trades, newest disclosure first. The paging tool: use it when get_member or get_stock's 20 most recent trades are not enough, or to walk the whole record. Filter by ticker, by member_id, by both (one member's trades in one stock), or by neither (every trade).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whats_new · Private data: get_member, list_transactions, list_recent_filings, get_filing, cluster_trades, congress_leaderboard, members_vs_market, stock_act_compliance · Public sink: members_vs_market, stock_act_compliance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whats_new · Private data: get_member, list_transactions, list_recent_filings, get_filing, cluster_trades, congress_leaderboard, members_vs_market, stock_act_compliance · Public sink: members_vs_market, stock_act_compliance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
